content: ort crate v2.0.0-rc.13 wraps ONNX Runtime 1.28. Key types: Session (main inference interface, requires &mut self), SessionBuilder, Value/Tensor/DynTensor for I/O. Execution providers: CUDA, TensorRT, CoreML, OpenVINO, ROCm via feature flags. EPs register in order, silently fall back to CPU. Use ort::init() for global env, SessionBuilder for per-model config. inputs! macro creates session inputs from ndarray. download-binaries feature (default) auto-downloads ORT shared libs.
